answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The oasis holds work receipts rather than names, so the fable of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The raven of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
